text:
kevin (support): FYI customer ACME Corp is seeing repeated key unseal failures during our scheduled audit re-encryption run. They started seeing errors ~02:10 UTC. They called in and asked for immediate ETA on a fix. :rotating_light:

maria (eng-security): thanks - can you paste the exact error from their logs? any error code?

kevin (support): customer pasted this snippet in their ticket:
```
2026-03-15T02:10:12Z ERROR reencrypt: unseal failed: UNSEAL_FAILED: cipher unwrap returned non-zero
stack: runtime/kms/unwrap.go:74 -> runtime/keystore/driver.go:211
```
They say it affects ~5% of objects and is blocking their audit window.

jun (sre): tagging @oncall-sre in case this needs pager. Do we know if this is specific to HSM pool us-west-2-hsm-a?

samir (eng-runtime): initial guess: looks like an unwrap error from the KMS provider. Could be a stale KEK or rolling key id mismatch during re-encrypt. Need the object metadata (key_version, wrapped_by) + HSM logs.

kevin (support): asked customer for object IDs and the API request IDs. sent a request for a sanitized log bundle.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2009876 - "key-unseal-failures during audit re-encryption" (severity: elevated)

maria (eng-security): while we wait, mitigation options: 1) pause re-encrypt job for that customer 2) force fallback to older KEK for unwrap 3) instruct customer to re-run on a subset. We should confirm whether rollback to previous key version is safe for their compliance scope.

olivia (acct-ops): i already told customer we can pause the job ASAP. they want an ETA for a patch or clear mitigation steps for their auditor.

samir (eng-runtime): can we reproduce locally? kevin, did they provide the request_id?

kevin (support): they gave req_id: req_0a7f3b9c. also attached masked object metadata: {"object":"obj-ACME-52","key_version":"v3","wrapped_by":"hsm-a-1"} (sanitized)

samir (eng-runtime): running quick repro against staging HSM shim with same inputs now. sharing results in a sec.

jun (sre): if this is HSM policy related we need provider support on standby. i'll open a vendor bridge in parallel.

samir (eng-runtime): repro shows unwrap returning status code 6 in our shim. stack trace points to mismatched key handle after recent key rotation job. reproducer command:
```bash
./tools/kms-unwrap --hsm hsm-a-1 --key-handle "hk-2026-v3" --ciphertext ct.bin
```
error: shim: unwrap failed: handle mismatch

maria (eng-security): confirm whether the rotation job wrote new handle mapping but some objects still point to old mapping. sounds like a race during the audit re-encrypt. we need a safe rollback plan and a fix to ensure atomic handle swaps.

jun (sre): vendor bridge up. vendor engineer asks for the exact shim logs and the rotation job ID. kevin can you upload the sanitized logs to the incident channel?

kevin (support): uploaded logs to secure share (internal link) and pinged vendor. customer asked: "is our data at risk?" I told them keys are not leaked; this is a decryption-availability issue.

maria (eng-security): agree. no evidence of exfil. we're focusing on availability and audit integrity. recommend we tell customer: pause job, we will rewrap affected objects with the previous KEK mapping, then re-run rotation with a strict drain.

olivia (acct-ops): customer needs a written timeline for auditors. can we give them an ETA for the mitigation?

samir (eng-runtime): quick mitigation plan and rough ETA: 1) Pause audit re-encrypt job (done) 2) Identify affected objects via request ids (1 hour) 3) Run targeted rewrap to previous KEK/v2 for affected objects (2-3 hours) 4) Run controlled rotation with handle-locking fix (patch + deploy) (ETA 6 hours for hotfix + 1 hour to validate)

maria (eng-security): agree with that plan. but call out risk: targeted rewrap must be idempotent and logged for audit. we'll produce an auditable manifest.

jun (sre): scheduling a maintenance window on the customer's tenant group. i'll coordinate with infra to ensure leader election on rotation controller is disabled during the operation.

incident-bot: vendor bridge: CONNECTED -> vendor-engineer@hsm-vendor.com

vendor-engineer (via vendor bridge): we see handle mismatch errors - we can assist with a remediation script to map legacy handles back for unwrap. need explicit object list and encrypted blobs.

kevin (support): customer confirmed they can provide object list and will start exporting masked blobs now.

olivia (acct-ops): i'll put together the auditor note. rough customer-facing statement: "We paused the audit re-encryption and are performing a targeted rewrap to ensure auditability. We expect initial fixes within 6 hours and a full verified hotfix within 8 hours." ok?

maria (eng-security): fine, but we should avoid promising exact hours. say "within 6-8 hours" and include mitigation steps.

kevin (support): sent updated note to customer with 6-8 hour window and asked for object exports. they acked. :thumbsup:

samir (eng-runtime): i'll prepare a backout + idempotent rewrap script and a dry-run against a small subset in staging. pushing a patch to the rotation controller to add handle-locking.

jun (sre): i'm on standby for rollout. will monitor HSM metrics and increase sampling on unwrap failures.

maria (eng-security): after mitigation, we'll produce an audit manifest and escalate to compliance for sign-off. also we need a postmortem timeline.

kevin (support): saving notes here. will update thread when customer provides object list. thanks all.

olivia (acct-ops): customer just sent object list (sanitized). forwarding to samir and vendor.

samir (eng-runtime): got it. starting targeted rewrap now (rolling batches). will report progress every 30m.

kevin (support): customer updated: "thanks, auditors notified, continue as planned."

maria (eng-security): marking incident severity as elevated -> controlled. good coordination.

jun (sre): monitoring shows unwrap error rate dropping as rewrap progresses. will update SLAs if needed.

samir (eng-runtime): rewrap complete for batch 1/5. no failures. continuing.

kevin (support): will close loop with ACME once all batches done.

olivia (acct-ops): preparing final customer communication template once we have full validation.

maria (eng-security): please preserve all logs and manifests for the post-incident audit. I'll start the compliance ticket.

kevin (support): closing note (for now) - mitigation in flight, vendor engaged, customer informed, ETA 6-8h for hotfix + validation. will reopen if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
